duckstation.desc: Legendary PS1 emulator — play PlayStation 1 games with higher resolution, filters, and modern enhancements.

details.definition: DuckStation is a fast and accurate PlayStation 1 emulator. It supports resolution upscaling, graphics filters, image enhancements, and save states for a modern experience.

requirements.cpu: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 (prefer a newer generation)

pcsx2.desc: The most powerful PS2 emulator — play PlayStation 2 games in high resolution with advanced graphics enhancements.

details.definition: PCSX2 is the leading PlayStation 2 emulator on PC. It offers high compatibility, resolution scaling, texture improvements, and modern rendering options.

requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400 (newer gen recommended)
requirements.gpu: DirectX 11 / Vulkan compatible (GTX 1050 / RX 560 or better recommended)

rpcs3.desc: The first PS3 emulator — run PlayStation 3 games on PC with great performance and high compatibility.

details.definition: RPCS3 is an open-source PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger. It focuses on accuracy and performance and supports a large library of PS3 titles.

requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 (4+ cores; 6+ recommended)
requirements.gpu: Vulkan compatible GPU (GTX 1060 / RX 580 or better recommended)

ppsspp.desc: Fast PSP emulator — play PSP games in HD quality with excellent smoothness.

details.definition: PPSSPP is a high-performance PSP emulator. It supports HD rendering, texture scaling, save states, and a wide range of controllers.

requirements.cpu: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 / AMD Athlon II X2 250 or better

dolphin.desc: Best Wii & GameCube emulator — excellent compatibility with HD support, mods, and enhancements.

details.definition: Dolphin is a mature emulator for Nintendo GameCube and Wii. It supports upscaling, widescreen hacks, texture packs, and many enhancements.

requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 (4+ cores)

cemu.desc: Powerful Wii U emulator — play Zelda and Mario with up to 4K resolution, great performance, and exclusive mods.

details.definition: Cemu is a high-performance Wii U emulator focused on accuracy and speed. It supports graphics packs, mods, and many popular Wii U games.

requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX-8350 (4+ cores)
requirements.gpu: DirectX 11 / OpenGL 4.5 (GTX 970 / RX 470 or better recommended)

ryujinx.desc: Popular Nintendo Switch emulator — run Switch games with high resolution and solid stability.

details.definition: Ryujinx is an open-source Nintendo Switch emulator focused on accuracy and usability. It supports many Switch titles and modern graphics backends.

requirements.cpu: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6+ cores)
requirements.gpu: Vulkan compatible GPU (GTX 1060 / RX 580 or better recommended)

citra.desc: Popular 3DS emulator — play Nintendo 3DS games with higher resolution and smooth performance.

details.definition: Citra is a well-known Nintendo 3DS emulator. It supports resolution scaling, texture enhancements, save states, and many popular 3DS games.

requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (strong single-core helps)

bsnes.desc: Most accurate SNES emulator — an authentic classic experience for Super Nintendo games.

details.definition: bsnes focuses on cycle-accurate emulation for Super Nintendo. It delivers very high accuracy for classic SNES titles.

xenia.desc: Experimental Xbox 360 emulator — run classic Xbox 360 games on PC.

details.definition: Xenia is an experimental Xbox 360 emulator. Compatibility varies by game, but it can run many titles with ongoing improvements.

requirements.cpu: Intel Core i7-6700K / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X (6+ cores)
requirements.gpu: Vulkan / DirectX 12 compatible GPU (GTX 1070 / RX Vega 56 or better recommended)

discord.desc: Voice and text chat with friends — the #1 communication app for gamers and communities.

details.definition: Discord is a free communication app with voice, text, and video chat. It’s built for communities, with servers, channels, and bots.
details.requirementsText: No special requirements — works on most modern PCs.

teamspeak.desc: High-quality voice chat — a professional alternative for voice communication while gaming.

details.definition: TeamSpeak is a lightweight voice chat client known for low latency and high audio quality, popular for competitive and team play.
details.requirementsText: No special requirements — works on most modern PCs.

obs.desc: The best free streaming tool — record and livestream in professional quality to Twitch and YouTube.

details.definition: OBS Studio is a free, open-source app for video recording and live streaming. It supports scenes, sources, capture devices, and plugins.

requirements.cpu: Quad-core CPU — Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
requirements.gpu: DirectX 10 compatible GPU (NVIDIA GTX 900+ / AMD RX 560+)

streamlabs.desc: Enhanced OBS — an easy UI with extra tools for streaming and viewer interaction.

details.definition: Streamlabs Desktop builds on OBS with an easier workflow, alerts, overlays, and tools designed for streamers.

requirements.cpu: Quad-core CPU — Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
requirements.gpu: DirectX 10 compatible GPU (NVIDIA GTX 900+ / AMD RX 560+)

afterburner.desc: GPU monitoring and overclocking — full control over performance, temps, and FPS stats.

details.definition: MSI Afterburner is a popular tool for monitoring and tweaking GPU settings (clock, voltage, fan curve) and displaying on-screen stats.
details.requirementsText: No special requirements — works with most NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

rivatuner.desc: On-screen performance overlay — FPS, temps, and resource usage while gaming.

details.definition: RivaTuner Statistics Server (RTSS) provides on-screen display and frame limiting, commonly used with MSI Afterburner.
details.requirementsText: No special requirements — works on most modern PCs.

geforce.desc: NVIDIA drivers and tools — auto updates and ShadowPlay to capture your best moments.

details.definition: GeForce Experience helps keep NVIDIA drivers up to date and provides game optimizations, recording, and streaming features.

amd.desc: Full AMD control suite — drivers and optimizations for AMD GPUs with built-in recording and streaming tools.

details.definition: AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition lets you manage AMD drivers and GPU settings, optimize games, and record/stream gameplay.

ds4windows.desc: Use PlayStation controllers on Windows — map DualShock/DualSense to XInput for better game/emulator compatibility.

details.definition: DS4Windows maps DualShock/DualSense controllers to XInput so they behave like an Xbox controller, improving compatibility.
details.requirementsText: Recommended to enable DS4Windows before launching the game. Admin privileges may be required on some devices.

overwolf.desc: Gaming app platform — in-game overlays, stats, and extra tools to enhance your experience.

details.definition: Overwolf is a platform for in-game apps and overlays. It enables add-ons like stats trackers, guides, and game utilities.
details.requirementsText: No special requirements — works on most modern PCs.
